scripts.dev: bun "$(ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if [ -f "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts" ]; then echo "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; else echo "$ROOT/oss/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; fi)" watch-bun ./src/server.ts
scripts.worker:dev: bun "$(ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if [ -f "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts" ]; then echo "$ROOT/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; else echo "$ROOT/oss/scripts/dev-tools/src/cli.ts"; fi)" watch-bun ./src/worker.ts
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: (sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org metorial --project mte-synthesis ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org metorial --project mte-synthesis ./dist) || true
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps:if-token: sh -c 'if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then bun run sentry:sourcemaps; else echo "Skipping Sentry sourcemap upload"; fi'
scripts.db:push:dev: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env; set +a; bun prisma db push --config ./prisma.config.ts --accept-data-loss'
